<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>نظام استئذان الطلاب - ثانوية المملكة العالمية</title>
    <!-- Tailwind CSS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <!-- SheetJS for Excel integration -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
    <!-- FontAwesome for icons -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <!-- Google Fonts Cairo -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        body {
            font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
            background-color: #f1f5f9;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="min-h-screen text-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between">

    <div id="app" class="flex-grow">
        <!-- Login View -->
        <div id="loginView" class="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen p-4">
            <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-md p-8 border border-slate-100">
                <div class="text-center mb-6">
                    <div id="loginLogoContainer" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-20 h-20 bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 rounded-2xl mb-3 shadow-inner overflow-hidden">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-graduation-cap text-4xl"></i>
                    </div>
                    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">نظام استئذان الطلاب</h1>
                    <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">ثانوية المملكة العالمية</p>
                </div>

                <form id="loginForm" onsubmit="handleLogin(event)" class="space-y-4">
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">اختر اسم المستخدم / الإداري</label>
                        <select id="loginUser" required class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:outline-none bg-slate-50">
                            <!-- Populated Dynamically -->
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">كلمة المرور</label>
                        <input type="password" id="loginPass" required placeholder="أدخل كلمة المرور" class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:outline-none bg-slate-50">
                    </div>

                    <div id="loginError" class="hidden text-red-500 text-xs text-center font-medium bg-red-50 p-2 rounded-lg"></div>

                    <button type="submit" class="w-full py-3 bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg transition duration-200">
                        تسجيل الدخول
                    </button>
                </form>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Dashboard View -->
        <div id="dashboardView" class="hidden min-h-screen flex flex-col">
            <!-- Top Navbar -->
            <header class="bg-white shadow-sm border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-30">
                <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 h-16 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div class="flex items-center space-x-3 space-x-reverse">
                        <div id="headerLogoContainer" class="w-10 h-10 bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-graduation-cap text-lg"></i>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <span class="font-bold text-slate-900 block leading-tight">ثانوية المملكة العالمية</span>
                            <span class="text-xs text-slate-500">نظام استئذان الطلاب</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center space-x-3 space-x-reverse">
                        <span id="currentUserDisplay" class="text-sm font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg"></span>
                        <button id="adminNavBtn" onclick="toggleAdminModal()" class="hidden px-3 py-1.5 text-sm bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-100 rounded-lg font-medium transition">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-gear ml-1"></i> لوحة المسؤول
                        </button>
                        <button onclick="logout()" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-sm bg-red-50 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-100 rounded-lg font-medium transition">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-right-from-bracket ml-1"></i> خروج
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </header>

            <!-- Main Workspace -->
            <main class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 flex-grow w-full">
                <!-- Navigation Tabs -->
                <div class="flex space-x-2 space-x-reverse mb-6 border-b border-slate-200 pb-3">
                    <button onclick="switchTab('newRequest')" id="tabBtn-newRequest" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm bg-teal-700 text-white shadow-sm transition">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus-circle ml-1"></i> استئذان جديد
                    </button>
                    <button onclick="switchTab('records')" id="tabBtn-records" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 transition">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-list-check ml-1"></i> سجل الاستئذان
                    </button>
                </div>

                <!-- Tab 1: New Request Form -->
                <div id="tab-newRequest" class="space-y-6">
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-6">
                        
                        <!-- Live Time/Date Display Header -->
                        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
                            <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines text-teal-700 ml-2"></i> إصدار بطاقة استئذان طالب
                            </h2>
                            <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 space-x-reverse bg-teal-50 border border-teal-100 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-teal-800 text-xs font-semibold self-start sm:self-auto">
                                <i class="fa-regular fa-clock text-teal-600"></i>
                                <span id="liveClockDisplay">جاري تحضير الوقت والتاريخ...</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <form id="requestForm" onsubmit="submitRequest(event)" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">اسم الطالب</label>
                                <div class="relative">
                                    <input type="text" id="studentName" list="studentsList" required placeholder="اكتب أو اختر اسم الطالب..." class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:outline-none" oninput="onStudentNameInput(this.value)">
                                    <datalist id="studentsList"></datalist>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">الصف / الفصل</label>
                                <input type="text" id="studentGrade" required placeholder="مثال: ثالث ثانوي أ" class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:outline-none">
                            </div>

                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">تاريخ الاستئذان (تلقائي)</label>
                                <input type="text" id="requestDate" readonly class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-teal-800 font-bold">
                            </div>

                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">وقت الاستئذان (تلقائي)</label>
                                <input type="text" id="requestTime" readonly class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-teal-800 font-bold">
                            </div>

                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">سبب الاستئذان</label>
                                <select id="leaveReason" required class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:outline-none">
                                    <option value="">اختر السبب...</option>
                                    <option value="ظرف خاص">ظرف خاص</option>
                                    <option value="موعد مستشفى">موعد مستشفى</option>
                                    <option value="مراجعة حكومية">مراجعة حكومية</option>
                                    <option value="أخرى">أخرى</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>

                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">الإداري المعتمد</label>
                                <input type="text" id="approvingAdmin" readonly class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-medium">
                            </div>

                            <div class="md:col-span-2 pt-4">
                                <button type="submit" class="w-full py-3.5 bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg transition duration-200 flex items-center justify-center">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-print ml-2"></i> حفظ وطباعة بطاقة الاستئذان
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </form>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Tab 2: Records Log -->
                <div id="tab-records" class="hidden space-y-6">
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-6">
                        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4 mb-6">
                            <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-database text-teal-700 ml-2"></i> سجل الاستئذانات الصادرة
                            </h2>
                            <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 space-x-reverse w-full sm:w-auto">
                                <button onclick="exportToExcel()" class="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-xl shadow-sm transition">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-file-excel ml-1"></i> تصدير إلى Excel
                                </button>
                                <button onclick="printFullReport()" class="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-4 py-2 bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-xl shadow-sm transition">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-print ml-1"></i> طباعة السجل (A4)
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                            <table class="w-full text-right border-collapse">
                                <thead class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 text-xs font-bold uppercase border-b border-slate-200">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th class="p-3">التاريخ</th>
                                        <th class="p-3">الوقت</th>
                                        <th class="p-3">اسم الطالب</th>
                                        <th class="p-3">الصف</th>
                                        <th class="p-3">السبب</th>
                                        <th class="p-3">المعتمد</th>
                                        <th class="p-3 text-center">الإجراءات</th>
                                    </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody id="recordsTableBody" class="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-sm">
                                    <!-- Dynamic rows -->
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </main>
        </div>

        <!-- Admin Settings Modal -->
        <div id="adminModal" class="hidden fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-xl p-6 border border-slate-200 space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center border-b pb-3">
                    <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900"><i class="fa-solid fa-gear text-amber-600 ml-2"></i> لوحة إدارة النظام</h3>
                    <button onclick="toggleAdminModal()" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 text-xl font-bold">&times;</button>
                </div>
                
                <div class="space-y-4 text-sm">
                    <!-- Excel Upload strictly placed inside Admin Panel -->
                    <div class="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300">
                        <span class="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">ربط ملف بيانات الطلاب (Excel)</span>
                        <span class="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-3">رفع ملف الاكسل لتحديث أسماء الطلاب وصفوفهم في النظام</span>
                        <label class="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium shadow-sm transition">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-upload ml-1 text-teal-700"></i> اختيار ملف Excel
                            <input type="file" id="excelFile" accept=".xlsx, .xls" onchange="handleExcelUpload(event)" class="hidden">
                        </label>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label class="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">تعديل كلمة مرور المسؤول الرئيسي (Admin)</label>
                        <div class="flex gap-2">
                            <input type="password" id="newAdminPass" placeholder="كلمة المرور الجديدة" class="flex-grow px-3 py-2 border rounded-xl">
                            <button onclick="updateAdminPassword()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 text-white font-medium rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-900">حفظ</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="border-t pt-4">
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
                            <span class="font-semibold text-slate-700">إدارة أسماء وكلمات مرور الإداريين</span>
                            <button onclick="addNewAdminRow()" class="text-xs bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-plus ml-1"></i> إضافة إداري جديد
                            </button>
                        </div>
                        <div id="adminsListContainer" class="space-y-3">
                            <!-- Populated dynamically -->
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="border-t pt-4 flex justify-end">
                    <button onclick="toggleAdminModal()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-medium rounded-xl">إغلاق</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // رابط الويب الخاص بقاعدة بيانات Google Sheets الخاصة بك:
        const GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzQHfm6XxMBS16xJycoU2C-tcZMyUFXRQSsbMmBRai9fqiOpG0qLS_DcwYZoryWsBcPfg/exec";

        // Default Passwords Mapping
        const DEFAULT_PASSWORDS = {
            "Admin": "371407",
            "عبدالهادي آل سلطان": "1230",
            "عبدالرحمن آل حصوصه": "1212",
            "محمد الفرشان": "1111",
            "غازي البقمي": "1010",
            "عبدالرحمن الشهري": "0909"
        };

        let adminsPasswords = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("admins_passwords")) || DEFAULT_PASSWORDS;
        let currentUser = localStorage.getItem("current_user") || null;
        let studentsDatabase = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("students_db")) || [];
        let requestsRecords = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("requests_records")) || [];
        
        // شعار المدرسة الثابت ككود Base64 دائم
        let customSchoolLogo = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";

        // دالة لجلب البيانات سحابياً من Google Sheets عند بدء التشغيل
        async function fetchCloudData() {
            if (!GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL) return;
            try {
                // جلب بيانات الطلاب
                const resStudents = await fetch(`${GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL}?action=getStudents`);
                const dataStudents = await resStudents.json();
                if (dataStudents && dataStudents.length > 1) {
                    studentsDatabase = [];
                    for (let i = 1; i < dataStudents.length; i++) {
                        const row = dataStudents[i];
                        if (row[1]) {
                            studentsDatabase.push({ name: String(row[1]).trim(), grade: String(row[2] || "").trim() });
                        }
                    }
                    updateStudentsDatalist();
                }

                // جلب سجلات الاستئذان
                const resPerms = await fetch(`${GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL}?action=getPermissions`);
                const dataPerms = await resPerms.json();
                if (dataPerms && dataPerms.length > 1) {
                    requestsRecords = [];
                    for (let i = 1; i < dataPerms.length; i++) {
                        const row = dataPerms[i];
                        if (row[1]) {
                            requestsRecords.unshift({
                                id: row[0] || Date.now(),
                                studentName: row[1],
                                studentGrade: row[2],
                                leaveReason: row[3],
                                requestDate: row[4],
                                requestTime: row[5],
                                approvingAdmin: row[6]
                            });
                        }
                    }
                    if (document.getElementById("tab-records") && !document.getElementById("tab-records").classList.contains("hidden")) {
                        renderRecords();
                    }
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.log("يعمل النظام حالياً بالتخزين المحلي لعدم توفر الاتصال السحابي أو الرابط:", err);
            }
        }

        function updateAppLogoDisplays() {
            const loginContainer = document.getElementById("loginLogoContainer");
            const headerContainer = document.getElementById("headerLogoContainer");

            if (customSchoolLogo) {
                const imgHtml = `<img src="${customSchoolLogo}" alt="Logo" class="w-full h-full object-contain p-1">`;
                if (loginContainer) loginContainer.innerHTML = imgHtml;
                if (headerContainer) headerContainer.innerHTML = imgHtml;
            } else {
                const defaultIcon = `<i class="fa-solid fa-graduation-cap text-4xl"></i>`;
                const headerDefaultIcon = `<i class="fa-solid fa-graduation-cap text-lg"></i>`;
                
                if (loginContainer) loginContainer.innerHTML = defaultIcon;
                if (headerContainer) headerContainer.innerHTML = headerDefaultIcon;
            }
        }

        function renderLoginUsersList() {
            const select = document.getElementById("loginUser");
            select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر اسم المستخدم...</option>';
            Object.keys(adminsPasswords).forEach(user => {
                const opt = document.createElement("option");
                opt.value = user;
                opt.textContent = user === "Admin" ? "المسؤول (Admin)" : user;
                select.appendChild(opt);
            });
        }

        // Real-time Clock & Automatic Live Date/Time Population
        function startLiveClock() {
            function updateClock() {
                const now = new Date();
                const dateOptions = { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' };
                const fullOptions = { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: true };

                const formattedFull = now.toLocaleDateString('ar-SA', fullOptions);
                const clockEl = document.getElementById("liveClockDisplay");
                if (clockEl) {
                    clockEl.textContent = formattedFull;
                }

                // Automatically populate inputs live
                const dateInput = document.getElementById("requestDate");
                const timeInput = document.getElementById("requestTime");
                if (dateInput) {
                    dateInput.value = now.toLocaleDateString('ar-SA', dateOptions);
                }
                if (timeInput) {
                    timeInput.value = now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-SA', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true });
                }
            }
            updateClock();
            setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
        }

        function handleLogin(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const user = document.getElementById("loginUser").value;
            const pass = document.getElementById("loginPass").value;
            const errDiv = document.getElementById("loginError");

            if (adminsPasswords[user] && adminsPasswords[user] === pass) {
                currentUser = user;
                localStorage.setItem("current_user", currentUser);
                showDashboard();
            } else {
                errDiv.textContent = "اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة!";
                errDiv.classList.remove("hidden");
            }
        }

        function logout() {
            currentUser = null;
            localStorage.removeItem("current_user");
            document.getElementById("loginPass").value = "";
            document.getElementById("loginUser").value = "";
            showLogin();
        }

        function showLogin() {
            renderLoginUsersList();
            updateAppLogoDisplays();
            document.getElementById("loginView").classList.remove("hidden");
            document.getElementById("dashboardView").classList.add("hidden");
        }

        function showDashboard() {
            document.getElementById("loginView").classList.add("hidden");
            document.getElementById("dashboardView").classList.remove("hidden");
            document.getElementById("currentUserDisplay").textContent = `المستخدم: ${currentUser}`;
            
            // Auto-lock approving admin
            document.getElementById("approvingAdmin").value = currentUser;

            if (currentUser === "Admin") {
                document.getElementById("adminNavBtn").classList.remove("hidden");
            } else {
                document.getElementById("adminNavBtn").classList.add("hidden");
            }

            updateAppLogoDisplays();
            updateStudentsDatalist();
            renderRecords();
            renderAdminsSettings();
            startLiveClock();
            fetchCloudData(); // جلب البيانات السحابية فور الدخول
        }

        function switchTab(tabId) {
            document.getElementById("tab-newRequest").classList.add("hidden");
            document.getElementById("tab-records").classList.add("hidden");
            document.getElementById("tabBtn-newRequest").className = "px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 transition";
            document.getElementById("tabBtn-records").className = "px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 transition";

            document.getElementById(`tab-${tabId}`).classList.remove("hidden");
            document.getElementById(`tabBtn-${tabId}`).className = "px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm bg-teal-700 text-white shadow-sm transition";

            if (tabId === 'records') {
                fetchCloudData();
                renderRecords();
            }
        }

        function handleExcelUpload(e) {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(e) {
                const data = new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
                const workbook = XLSX.read(data, {type: 'array'});
                const firstSheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
                const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[firstSheetName];
                const json = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, {header: 1});
                
                studentsDatabase = [];
                for (let i = 1; i < json.length; i++) {
                    const row = json[i];
                    if (row && row.length > 0) {
                        const name = row[0] ? String(row[0]).trim() : "";
                        const grade = row[1] ? String(row[1]).trim() : "";
                        if (name) {
                            studentsDatabase.push({name, grade});
                        }
                    }
                }
                localStorage.setItem("students_db", JSON.stringify(studentsDatabase));
                updateStudentsDatalist();
                alert(`تم استيراد ${studentsDatabase.length} طالب بنجاح!`);
            };
            reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
        }

        function updateStudentsDatalist() {
            const list = document.getElementById("studentsList");
            list.innerHTML = "";
            studentsDatabase.forEach(st => {
                const opt = document.createElement("option");
                opt.value = st.name;
                opt.textContent = st.grade ? `الصف: ${st.grade}` : '';
                list.appendChild(opt);
            });
        }

        function onStudentNameInput(val) {
            const found = studentsDatabase.find(st => st.name === val.trim());
            if (found && found.grade) {
                document.getElementById("studentGrade").value = found.grade;
            }
        }

        function openPrintWindow(contentHtml, pageSizeCss) {
            const printWin = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=900,height=700');
            if (!printWin) {
                alert("يرجى السماح بالنوافذ المنبثقة للطباعة المباشرة.");
                return;
            }
            printWin.document.write(`
                <!DOCTYPE html>
                <html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
                <head>
                    <meta charset="UTF-8">
                    <title>طباعة</title>
                    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
                    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
                    <style>
                        @page { ${pageSizeCss} margin: 0; }
                        body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: white; font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif; }
                    </style>
                </head>
                <body>
                    ${contentHtml}
                    <script>
                        window.onload = function() {
                            window.focus();
                            window.print();
                            setTimeout(function(){ window.close(); }, 500);
                        }
                    <\/script>
                </body>
                </html>
            `);
            printWin.document.close();
        }

        async function submitRequest(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const now = new Date();
            const record = {
                id: Date.now(),
                requestDate: document.getElementById("requestDate").value || now.toLocaleDateString('ar-SA'),
                requestTime: document.getElementById("requestTime").value || now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-SA', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true }),
                studentName: document.getElementById("studentName").value.trim(),
                studentGrade: document.getElementById("studentGrade").value.trim(),
                leaveReason: document.getElementById("leaveReason").value,
                approvingAdmin: document.getElementById("approvingAdmin").value
            };

            requestsRecords.unshift(record);
            localStorage.setItem("requests_records", JSON.stringify(requestsRecords));
            
            // إرسال البيانات بشكل آمن إلى Google Sheets سحابياً
            if (GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL) {
                try {
                    await fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, {
                        method: "POST",
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            action: "addPermission",
                            data: {
                                id: record.id,
                                studentName: record.studentName,
                                class: record.studentGrade,
                                reason: record.leaveReason,
                                date: record.requestDate,
                                time: record.requestTime,
                                approvedBy: record.approvingAdmin
                            }
                        })
                    });
                } catch (err) {
                    console.log("فشل الحفظ السحابي المؤقت، تم الحفظ محلياً:", err);
                }
            }

            // Execute Guaranteed Popup Print
            printA6Card(record);

            document.getElementById("requestForm").reset();
            document.getElementById("approvingAdmin").value = currentUser;
        }

        function printA6Card(rec) {
            const dateStr = rec.requestDate || (rec.date ? rec.date.split(' ')[0] : '');
            const timeStr = rec.requestTime || (rec.date ? rec.date.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ') : '');

            const logoHeaderHtml = customSchoolLogo 
                ? `<div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 4px;"><img src="${customSchoolLogo}" style="max-height: 48px; max-width: 100px; object-fit: contain;"></div>`
                : `<div style="font-size: 24px; color: #0f766e; margin-bottom: 2px; text-align: center;"><i class="fa-solid fa-graduation-cap"></i></div>`;

            const cardHTML = `
                <div style="width: 10.5cm; height: 14.8cm; margin: 0 auto; padding: 6mm; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; direction: rtl; background: #ffffff; font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif; border: 2px solid #0f766e; border-radius: 8px; position: relative;">
                    <div style="border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; height: 100%; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5mm; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; border-radius: 6px; background: #fafafa;">
                        
                        <div style="text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px solid #0f766e; padding-bottom: 6px;">
                            ${logoHeaderHtml}
                            <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f766e;">ثانوية المملكة العالمية</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #334155; margin-top: 2px;">بطاقة استئذان خروج طالب</div>
                        </div>

                        <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #1e293b;">
                            <div style="background: #ffffff; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                                <span style="font-weight: bold; color: #0f766e; display: inline-block; width: 22%;">اسم الطالب:</span>
                                <span style="font-weight: 700;">${rec.studentName}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="background: #ffffff; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                                <span style="font-weight: bold; color: #0f766e; display: inline-block; width: 22%;">الصف/الفصل:</span>
                                <span style="font-weight: 700;">${rec.studentGrade}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="background: #ffffff; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                                <span style="font-weight: bold; color: #0f766e; display: inline-block; width: 22%;">سبب الخروج:</span>
                                <span style="font-weight: 700;">${rec.leaveReason}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px;">
                                <div style="flex: 1; background: #ffffff; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; text-align: center;">
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b;">التاريخ</div>
                                    <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px;">${dateStr}</div>
                                </div>
                                <div style="flex: 1; background: #ffffff; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; text-align: center;">
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: #64748b;">وقت الاستئذان</div>
                                    <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px;">${timeStr}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div style="border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; padding-top: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 11px;">
                            <div>
                                <span style="color: #64748b;">المسؤول المعتمد:</span> 
                                <span style="font-weight: bold; color: #0f766e;">${rec.approvingAdmin}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="text-align: center;">
                                <div style="font-size: 9px; color: #94a3b8;">ختم المدرسة</div>
                                <div style="width: 50px; height: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1; margin: 0 auto;"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            openPrintWindow(cardHTML, "size: A6 portrait;");
        }

        function renderRecords() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById("recordsTableBody");
            tbody.innerHTML = "";
            if (requestsRecords.length === 0) {
                tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center p-6 text-slate-400">لا توجد سجلات استئذان حتى الآن</td></tr>`;
                return;
            }
            requestsRecords.forEach((rec, idx) => {
                const tr = document.createElement("tr");
                tr.className = "hover:bg-slate-50 transition";
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td class="p-3 font-medium text-slate-600">${rec.requestDate || (rec.date ? rec.date.split(' ')[0] : '')}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-slate-600">${rec.requestTime || (rec.date ? rec.date.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ') : '')}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 font-bold text-slate-800">${rec.studentName}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-slate-600">${rec.studentGrade || rec.class}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-slate-600">${rec.leaveReason || rec.reason}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 font-semibold text-teal-700">${rec.approvingAdmin || rec.approvedBy}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-center space-x-1 space-x-reverse">
                        <button onclick='printA6Card(${JSON.stringify(rec)})' class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-100 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition" title="إعادة طباعة البطاقة">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-print"></i>
                        </button>
                    </td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        function toggleAdminModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById("adminModal");
            modal.classList.toggle("hidden");
            if (!modal.classList.contains("hidden")) {
                renderAdminsSettings();
            }
        }

        function renderAdminsSettings() {
            const container = document.getElementById("adminsListContainer");
            container.innerHTML = "";
            Object.keys(adminsPasswords).forEach(user => {
                if (user === "Admin") return; // Admin الرئيسي له خانة مخصصة
                const div = document.createElement("div");
                div.className = "flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-50 p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200";
                div.innerHTML = `
                    <input type="text" value="${user}" id="admin_name_${user}" class="flex-grow px-3 py-1.5 border rounded-lg bg-white text-sm" placeholder="اسم الإداري">
                    <input type="text" value="${adminsPasswords[user]}" id="admin_pass_${user}" class="w-28 px-3 py-1.5 border rounded-lg bg-white text-sm" placeholder="كلمة المرور">
                    <button onclick="saveAdminChanges('${user}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-teal-700 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-teal-800">تحديث</button>
                    <button onclick="deleteAdminUser('${user}')" class="px-2 py-1.5 bg-red-50 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-100 rounded-lg text-xs" title="حذف">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i>
                    </button>
                `;
                container.appendChild(div);
            });
        }

        function addNewAdminRow() {
            const name = prompt("أدخل اسم الإداري الجديد:");
            if (!name) return;
            const pass = prompt("أدخل كلمة المرور للإداري الجديد:");
            if (!pass) return;
            adminsPasswords[name] = pass;
            localStorage.setItem("admins_passwords", JSON.stringify(adminsPasswords));
            renderAdminsSettings();
            renderLoginUsersList();
            alert("تم إضافة الإداري بنجاح!");
        }

        function saveAdminChanges(oldName) {
            const newName = document.getElementById(`admin_name_${oldName}`).value.trim();
            const newPass = document.getElementById(`admin_pass_${oldName}`).value.trim();
            if (!newName || !newPass) {
                alert("الرجاء إدخال الاسم وكلمة المرور!");
                return;
            }
            if (newName !== oldName) {
                delete adminsPasswords[oldName];
            }
            adminsPasswords[newName] = newPass;
            localStorage.setItem("admins_passwords", JSON.stringify(adminsPasswords));
            renderAdminsSettings();
            renderLoginUsersList();
            alert("تم تحديث بيانات الإداري بنجاح!");
        }

        function deleteAdminUser(username) {
            if (confirm(`هل أنت متأكد من حذف الإداري (${username})؟`)) {
                delete adminsPasswords[username];
                localStorage.setItem("admins_passwords", JSON.stringify(adminsPasswords));
                renderAdminsSettings();
                renderLoginUsersList();
            }
        }

        function updateAdminPassword() {
            const newPass = document.getElementById("newAdminPass").value.trim();
            if (!newPass) {
                alert("الرجاء إدخال كلمة المرور الجديدة للمسؤول!");
                return;
            }
            adminsPasswords["Admin"] = newPass;
            localStorage.setItem("admins_passwords", JSON.stringify(adminsPasswords));
            document.getElementById("newAdminPass").value = "";
            alert("تم تحديث كلمة مرور المسؤول الرئيسي بنجاح!");
        }

        function exportToExcel() {
            const dataToExport = requestsRecords.map(r => ({
                "التاريخ": r.requestDate || '',
                "الوقت": r.requestTime || '',
                "اسم الطالب": r.studentName || '',
                "الصف": r.studentGrade || r.class || '',
                "سبب الاستئذان": r.leaveReason || r.reason || '',
                "المسؤول المعتمد": r.approvingAdmin || r.approvedBy || ''
            }));
            const worksheet = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(dataToExport);
            const workbook = XLSX.utils.book_new();
            XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(workbook, worksheet, "سجل الاستئذان");
            XLSX.writeFile(workbook, "سجل_استئذان_الطلاب.xlsx");
        }

        function printFullReport() {
            let rowsHtml = "";
            requestsRecords.forEach(r => {
                rowsHtml += `
                    <tr>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">${r.requestDate || ''}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">${r.requestTime || ''}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; font-weight: bold;">${r.studentName}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">${r.studentGrade || r.class || ''}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">${r.leaveReason || r.reason || ''}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">${r.approvingAdmin || r.approvedBy || ''}</td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            const reportHtml = `
                <div style="padding: 15mm; direction: rtl; font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;">
                    <div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px;">
                        <h2 style="margin: 0; font-size: 18px; color: #0f766e;">ثانوية المملكة العالمية</h2>
                        <h3 style="margin: 5px 0 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: #334155;">تقرير سجل استئذان الطلاب الشامل</h3>
                    </div>
                    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; text-align: right;">
                        <thead>
                            <tr style="background: #f1f5f9; color: #334155;">
                                <th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">التاريخ</th>
                                <th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">الوقت</th>
                                <th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">اسم الطالب</th>
                                <th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">الصف</th>
                                <th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">السبب</th>
                                <th style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">المعتمد</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            ${rowsHtml}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            `;
            openPrintWindow(reportHtml, "size: A4 portrait;");
        }

        window.onload = function() {
            renderLoginUsersList();
            updateAppLogoDisplays();
        };
    </script>
</body>
</html>
